verses.1: On that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah. It is a city of great importance and glory. It will be a place of peace and joy.
verses.2: Open the doors, and let the righteous nation enter, who keep the truth.
verses.3: He created a place of peace and tranquility, because in you lies peace.
verses.4: Trust in the LORD forever, for in Him the LORD is eternal.
verses.5: For the inhabitants of Marom Kriya have been destroyed. They have been reduced to nothingness; their ruins will reach as far as the land of Yagienna, and even further.
verses.6: Tirmesena, legs of the poor, feet of those who are destitute.
verses.7: Let the righteous be hospitable among the wicked. The righteous are those who are upright and honest. They are truly righteous people.
verses.8: May all those who are under your judgment be blessed by your name and may they remember you with reverence.
verses.9: My soul is in pain during the night; my spirit is distressed within me. I weep for you, because as your judgments are made in righteousness, so too shall the inhabitants of Tabor be taught.
verses.10: The wicked will not learn righteousness in the land where they live. They will not see the glory of Jehovah.
verses.11: Yehova, may your hand be strong enough to withstand their attempts. May they be defeated by your power. Even if fire were needed, you would still be able to defeat them.
verses.12: Yehovah will bring us peace, for even all our actions have been done for our benefit.
verses.13: Yehovah, our God, in your own name, we will remember your name alone.
verses.14: The dead will not live; the sick will not recover. So you have punished them, and destroyed all traces of them.
verses.15: You have filled the nations with God’s glory. You have been exalted; you have been separated from all other nations on earth.
verses.16: Yehova, in your suffering, you were punished for the secrets you revealed. You were given over to others.
verses.17: Just as a woman who is about to give birth cries out in her pain, so too were we before you, Jehovah.
verses.18: We have wept and suffered, just as children do. The spirit of redemption has come; the land will not be destroyed, and those who dwell in darkness will not fall.
verses.19: They will live from among you, my prophets. They will rise up and sing. The inhabitants of Aphar will rejoice, for the rain will fall upon your land, and the earth will be healed.
verses.20: Go with my people into your house. And close the door behind you for a moment, until the anger passes.
verses.21: For behold, Jehovah will come out from His place to deal with the calamity that has befallen the earth. The earth will no longer cover its wounds, and it will no longer be able to bear any more suffering.
